target: Exact Figure12 / Appendix H.2 Gross circuit in arXiv:2603.05481v1
reason: The closed new-window delta covered repository and arXiv updates but not the author's machine-readable circuit deposit. This successor adds that distinct authoritative channel without reopening closed checks.
canonical_preregistration: This file is staging input only. Copy exact bytes to the successor inputs/preregistration.json and verify its SHA256 against manifest.prereg_sha256 before any live deposit retrieval.
scope: Resolve the concept DOI to its current published version and compare version identity, publication/modification metadata and publisher file descriptors with the pinned baseline. Follow exact publisher links only as needed to resolve the current version. A different/new-to-baseline version is eligible even if publication predates the last campaign close, because this deposit delta was not previously performed.
eligibility: Inspect newly exposed versions, materially changed construction-file descriptors, or newly modified target-relevant metadata/links. If version, scientific metadata and file descriptors are unchanged, do not download or inventory the closed zip again. Ignore changing usage statistics as construction evidence.
provenance: Store complete response bytes, requested/final URLs and redirect resolution, retrieval UTC, HTTP outcomes, SHA256, concept/version DOI and publication/modified dates. Publisher file checksums are metadata, not a claim that this run rehashed the zip. A failed resolution is not absence; use an available alternate public publisher route.
preserve: all closed runs, status and hash manifests
admission_requires: Exact Figure12 endpoint/monomial and X/Z binding
Author-defined slightly modified LRC shared clocks and cycle association
Exact finite preparation/readout/idle operation and error-location set
downstream_gate: Only after exact admission: derive independent primitive physical faults, validate replay and negative controls, then run the inherited capped assay. No substitute circuit or outreach.
stop: If no newly eligible construction or clarification is recovered, document the exact remaining external input, freeze and close FROZEN-INCONCLUSIVE through campaign.py. No distance bounds from inconclusive source evidence.
